mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals an economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 AND INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7%), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) are associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as they indicate a strengthening economy and increased consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above 500, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 220.5 signals inflationary pressure that increases the risk of central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 220.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 500 and CPIAUCSL is below 220, it signals a strong economy without inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 500 AND CPIAUCSL < 220, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95), the S&P 500 tends to have negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced business activity and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
